subject.title: /new and /reset should support @agent targeting in multi-agent channels

question: In multi-agent channels, should `/new` and `/reset` require an explicit agent target when more than one agent could match, and what should happen when no target is supplied?
rationale: The code boundary is clear, but the safe behavior changes user-visible command semantics and cross-agent authorization, so automation should not choose the permanent policy alone.

options.title: Require explicit target when ambiguous
options.body: Add an agent mention/slash parameter path and fail or prompt when multiple agents are present without a selected target.

options.title: Keep route-based default plus optional target
options.body: Preserve current bare-command routing and add explicit target support only for users who opt into it.

options.title: Defer to broader reset policy work
options.body: Leave this issue open until per-agent or per-binding reset policy is designed with the related session reset requests.

recommendation.title: Require explicit target when ambiguous
recommendation.body: Add an agent mention/slash parameter path and fail or prompt when multiple agents are present without a selected target.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history on the native command target helper and Discord routing hardening involved in the policy choice.
